svg.title: Private Gateway traffic
svg.desc: Client identity crosses HAProxy with Proxy Protocol v2; TLS terminates on the edge workers.

g.text: Client identity crosses HAProxy with Proxy Protocol v2; TLS terminates on the edge workers.
Other IPv4 and IPv6 sources are dropped.
Envoy uses the Proxy Protocol source address.
Zero trusted XFF hops; client headers cannot override it.
HTTP redirects to HTTPS. Hubble UI has no built-in login; access is limited to lab/Tailscale networks.
